title: Character
description: One playable character. Owned and written ONLY by its player's client. schemaVersion is required on every record; all future changes must be additive with defaults.

playerKey.description: The human behind the character. Links to players/{playerKey}/profile.json

origin.description: The people they were born to; determines their native crafts. SNG-658: the enum is the id list of content/packs/core/rules/origins.json (27 peoples). It said harmonic/radiant/valley, three ids from before the peoples were authored. Older saves still carry `valley` and `radiant`: reconcile.js renames them (valleyfolk, radiant_plateau) at load, so a raw save file can fail here until it is next written. Keep this enum equal to origins.json; a gate should derive it rather than trust the literal.

background.description: e.g. former-professional, community-organizer, craftsman, survivalist, medic

attributes.description: 1-4 at creation (12 points), can grow to 6

alignment.description: 12-axis spectrum fingerprint, spectrumId -> [-1,1]. Accumulates from actions via EWMA.

attunement.description: Governs sense-of-success tier. Grows with ability use and level.

inventory.description: SNG-658: what the character carries. Each entry is an OBJECT (a catalog item plus the character's own state), because that is what inventory.js writes and every reader takes; the earlier `string` items described a shape no save has held. Measured on 93 entries across 16 saves: name, kind and qty on all of them; id on all, but null on GM-made things.

id.description: catalog key; relinks the entry to its bonuses. null for a thing the GM made in play (a letter, a map, a found tool), which has no catalog entry: 57 of 93 carried entries. Such an item hooks rolls only through its own bonusTags.

effects.description: consumables: numeric pools restored, e.g. { energy: 10 }

customName.description: the name the player gave it

grants.description: earned powers bound into it (earnedpower.js clamps them)

deeds.description: Append-only memorable actions. Reputation with any community derives from deeds it has witnessed/heard of.

communityId.description: Community that witnessed it. null = unwitnessed (still shapes alignment, not reputation).

tags.description: e.g. child-rescuer, thief, peacemaker, violent, scholar

spread.description: Other communityIds that have since heard of it (world-tick fills this in v0.3).

chronicle.description: One-line summaries per scene, oldest first. Compressed when long.

activeScene.description: Serialized in-progress scene so a closed tab resumes exactly where it left off.

partyForward.description: Who the player has chosen to bring FORWARD in a fight — the named places closeness buys (CCODE-511). Read by `lineSplit`; absent means the engine chooses, and everyone else stands in the line as they are able.

gearTaken.description: what has already been taken from whose gear — person id → the gear lines that left them (SNG-660 §2b.2). ⛔ IT LIVES ON THE CHARACTER BECAUSE THE PERSON MAY NOT BE SAVED: a registry npc's `gear` persists, an AUTHORED one's roster record reloads fresh, so without this the same crown could be handed over again tomorrow.
